description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveEntitlementDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It manages leave entitlement data operations such as retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting entitlements, as well as calculating leave balances and related functionalities. It interacts with the database via Doctrine ORM and implements various business logic related to employee leave entitlements.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing leave entitlement records, including retrieval, persistence, deletion, and complex business operations related to employee leave entitlements within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getPendingStatusIds
methods.description: Returns an array of leave status IDs that are pending approval.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Fetches leave entitlement records based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave entitlement records matching the search criteria.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsSum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of the 'noOfDays' field for leave entitlements matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Retrieves a specific LeaveEntitlement entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Persists a LeaveEntitlement entity to the database and links it to unused leave, handling transactions.

methods.name: getExistingLeaveEntitlementIds
methods.description: Fetches existing leave entitlement IDs from the database based on provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementsByIds
methods.description: Retrieves leave entitlement entities for a given list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Marks leave entitlement records as deleted by setting a deleted flag.

methods.name: bulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Assigns leave entitlements to multiple employees in a transactional manner, including logic for existing entitlements and leave period handling.

methods.name: getValidLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Returns leave entitlements valid for a particular employee within a date range, ordered by specified field.

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the leave balance for an employee and leave type as of a specific date.

methods.name: getEntitlementUsageForLeave
methods.description: Retrieves usage information of entitlements for a specific leave.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlements
methods.description: Fetches leaves that are not linked to any entitlement within a date range for given employees and leave type.

methods.name: getMatchingEntitlements
methods.description: Returns leave entitlements matching employee number and optional date ranges and leave type.

methods.name: getLeaveTypesForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Retrieves leave types for entitlement usage reports based on provided search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeesForEntitlementUsageReport
methods.description: Fetches employees involved in entitlement usage reports following search criteria.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIdsForEntitlementsByEmployee
methods.description: Returns leave type IDs for granted entitlements of a specific employee within optional date ranges.
